017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * A revision-neutral, immutable subscription filter: the set of change kinds and resource URIs one
023 * {@link McpSubscription} is interested in.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * Concrete (not an interface) on purpose: a v2 adapter reads the honored values back off this type to
027 * build the {@code notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged} frame, so it needs field-level accessors, not
028 * just the {@link #matches(McpChangeEvent)} predicate.
029 *
030 * @param toolsListChanged Whether the tool list-changed signal is honored.
031 * @param promptsListChanged Whether the prompt list-changed signal is honored.
032 * @param resourcesListChanged Whether the resource list-changed signal is honored.
033 * @param resourceUris The exact resource URIs subscribed to for {@code resourceUpdated} events. Can be
034 *    {@code null} (treated as empty).
035 */
036public record McpSubscriptionFilter(boolean toolsListChanged, boolean promptsListChanged, boolean resourcesListChanged,
037      Set<String> resourceUris) {
038
039   /**
040    * Canonical constructor.
041    *
042    * <p>
043    * Normalizes {@code resourceUris} to an unmodifiable, insertion-ordered copy (empty when {@code null}).
044    */
045   public McpSubscriptionFilter {
046      resourceUris = resourceUris == null ? Collections.emptySet()
047         : Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(resourceUris));
048   }
049
050   /**
051    * Returns whether this filter opted into the given event's change kind (and, for
052    * {@link McpChangeKind#RESOURCE_UPDATED}, its exact resource URI).
053    *
054    * @param event The event to test. A {@code null} event never matches.
055    * @return {@code true} if this filter honors the event.
056    */
057   public boolean matches(McpChangeEvent event) {
058      if (event == null)
059         return false;
060      return switch (event.kind()) {
061         case TOOLS_LIST_CHANGED -> toolsListChanged;
062         case PROMPTS_LIST_CHANGED -> promptsListChanged;
063         case RESOURCES_LIST_CHANGED -> resourcesListChanged;
064         case RESOURCE_UPDATED -> resourceUris.contains(event.resourceUri());
065      };
066   }
067}
